messages.subject: poppr version 2.4.1 released
parts:
Poppr version 2.4.1 has officially been released and is on CRAN. This update is strongly recommended.

For details, see https://github.com/grunwaldlab/poppr/releases/tag/v.2.4.1

To update on your system, simply enter into your R console:

install.packages("poppr", repos = "https://cran.rstudio.com")

Once you update, please ensure that your version is 2.4.1 and not 2.4.0

This version contains new features such as jack.ia(), which will randomly subset your data and calculate the index of association, color graphs for mlg.table(), and a completely overhauled psex() calculation with method = "multiple". In addition, genlight/snpclone objects will now have MLGs calculated via distance-based methods automatically (which is different from previous behavior where they were initially considered unique and you had to use mlg.filter() to delineate them).

Several important bugs were fixed in this version, which included several fixes to read.genalex(), fix_replen(),  win.ia(), and all functions that utilize round-robin allele frequencies rraf() with multiple populations.

Cheers,
Zhian
